name: Molecular Data Inc.
summary: Molecular Data Inc. (MDI), operating through its various subsidiaries, specializes in digital commerce for the chemical sector within China. The company leverages an advanced technology platform to seamlessly connect stakeholders across the entire chemical supply chain by offering a comprehensive suite of integrated solutions. These offerings include digital commerce services, financial solutions, warehousing and logistics management, and bespoke Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) applications, all tailored for participants in the traditional chemical industry. MDI's e-commerce presence is primarily facilitated through its online portals, such as the molbase.com and molbase.cn websites, the Moku Data Weixin account, the Chemical Community mobile application, and other supporting digital channels. Established in 2013, Molecular Data Inc. maintains its primary operational base in Shanghai, China.
